condition.notes: Load-switch rail missing (LCD VDD, USB VBUS, or PCIe 12V slot power). First step is always resistance to ground with power disconnected.

next_steps.action: Disconnect all power. For desktop PCIe, unplug from mains and wait 60 s. For laptop USB/LCD, disconnect adapter and battery. Measure resistance from the rail to ground.

measure.where: Rail test point: PCIe slot B1/B2/B3 pins (12V), USB VBUS pin, or LCD VDD fuse
measure.instrument: DMM resistance mode (200 ohm then 2 kohm)
measure.expected: PCIe 12V typically >100 ohm; USB VBUS typically >50 ohm; LCD VDD typically >50 ohm. <10 ohm indicates a hard short on the rail or its load.
measure.safety: Discharge all caps before measuring. PCIe slots carry 12V at significant current — never short adjacent pins.

interpretations.then: Hard short. For PCIe, suspect a shorted GPU/add-in card or a shorted slot cap. For USB, suspect a shorted port protector or a shorted peripheral. Do NOT apply power until the short is found.
No short. For PCIe 12V, the rail comes directly from ATX_12V — check that ATX_12V is up (RULE_ATX_003_CHECK_PS_ON). For USB VBUS / LCD VDD, proceed to check the load-switch input and EN.
